feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing, with gales later.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline, as a deepening low in the Atlantic drives frontal systems across the area later today.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, becoming Variable 2 or 3 later this morning, settling east or southeast 4 or 5 in the afternoon, then increasing 5 to 7 in the evening, then 7 or gale 8 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight this morning, then building moderate or rough overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then fair, rain spreading from the southwest later this evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 7 or gale 8, becoming Cyclonic 5 to 7, decreasing 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, becoming occasional later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
